changelog:
- Initial release of the "openclaw-guide-uk" skill, providing a comprehensive Ukrainian-language guide to OpenClaw.
- Includes instructions for installation, configuration, channels, plugins, skills, memory, earning features, and security.
- Covers example configurations for popular messengers (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord), and model providers (cloud, local).
- Features detailed tables, quick-start commands, and guidance for both beginners and advanced users.
- Lists resources for further help and community links.
summary: Повний гід OpenClaw українською — встановлення, налаштування, скіли, плагіни, канали, безпека
